morgan: @auditor_garcia just asked for a live playback of last week's RBAC rollout + KMS access trail. Need to confirm what we can provide and how we'll redact. cc @elaine @sam

elaine: we can provide session logs + k8s RoleBinding diffs plus KMS crypto-logs. auditor will need a signed manifest. any constraints on non-prod creds?

sam: oncall here — we retain 90d of audit logs in Splunk; can export a presigned S3 bundle with access hashes, but we'll need to scrub user PII. also FYI some ephemeral service accounts will appear in the window.

morgan: auditor asked for chain-of-custody proof that rotations didn't impact decrypts. they want rotation timeline + signed CMK ARN list and mapping to deploys.

auditor_garcia: quick Q: can you include the KMS rotation event ids and the kube audit event ids that map to the same deploy window? a sample CSV mapping is fine. also would like the hash of the exported bundle for integrity checks.

elaine: yes. plan: export `rotation_events.csv` and `kube_audit_slice.csv`. we'll map by timestamp and PR number. we'll produce a presigned S3 with `manifest.json` signed by ops-signer (sha256).

sam: note: per policy we must remove stack traces and exception payloads. i'll run the scrub script: `scripts/scrub-logs --pii --exceptions` and attach the scrub-log.txt. also will replace email addresses with <redacted-email>.

morgan: action items:
- elaine: produce exports + signed manifest
- sam: run scrub and upload bundle
- morgan: prepare mapping spreadsheet + short playback notes (commands + expected output)
auditor_garcia, is that acceptable? :slightly_smiling_face:

auditor_garcia: That's perfect. Also please include a short runbook for replay (commands and env vars) and 2 screenshots of the console ACL view. one filtered to the audit window.

elaine: will include runbook snippet and two filtered screenshots. expected delivery EOD tomorrow. tagging @deploy-bot to capture deploy id logs.
